## Checklists
- [ ] Acceptance criteria demonstrated (incl. negative + isolation cases)
- [ ] Unit tests added; coverage not reduced
- [ ] Integration tests added or updated
- [ ] Isolation suite extended (if a new data path was added)
- [ ] Benchmarks run (if a hot path changed) — result: ____
- [ ] Public API: no change / additive / **breaking (ADR linked)**
- [ ] XML docs on all new public members
- [ ] No TODO, no placeholder, no hardcoded value
- [ ] Threat model impact considered — describe or state "none"
- [ ] Compliance controls affected — list or state "none"
- [ ] Rollback: how is this reverted safely?
